index_metadata.document_name: Consolidated Four-Candidate Evidence Index & OpenBot Reserve Note

candidate_a.name: Hermes Agent
required_custom_integrations: Docker Container per-tenant isolation (to resolve single-tenant state.db)
known_failures_and_constraints: Windows git file-lock during clone (resolved via git reset --hard HEAD)
Rejects models with context window < 64k tokens (e.g., gpt-4o-mini rejected)
Base system prompt & tool overhead ~55 KB per turn

candidate_b.name: MausBot
candidate_b.architecture: Computer-Using Agent (CUA) Desktop & Visual Browser GUI (Electron/Chromium)
key_native_features: Visual Element Recognition via Vision Models
required_custom_integrations: Virtual Display Server (Xvfb/RDP) for headless VPS
known_failures_and_constraints: Misclicks on dynamic UI overlays / animated popups
Instant crash on headless Linux without display buffer

candidate_c.name: Rakazo
candidate_c.architecture: Enterprise Workflow Orchestration & DAG Pipeline Engine
key_native_features: Deterministic Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) Pipeline Execution
Enterprise Audit Logging & Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
known_failures_and_constraints: Rigid execution schema unsuitable for unguided creative generation
Proprietary license fee scaling at multi-tenant volume

candidate_d.name: CrewAI
required_custom_integrations: External Vector DB / SQLite Persistence Layer (Memory is stateless by default)
External Task Scheduler (Celery / Redis Queue / OS Cron)
known_failures_and_constraints: High token amplification (3x-5x token cost compared to single tool-calling agent)
Potential infinite conversational loops between agents if max_iter is not bounded

reserve_candidate_note.name: OpenBot
reserve_candidate_note.architecture: Physical Computing / Smartphone Robotics Agent (Android / Arduino)
reserve_candidate_note.evaluation_summary: Evaluated strictly as an informational reserve. Unsuitable for primary digital marketing worker SaaS due to physical sensor/motor orientation and high OS latency. Archived for future physical retail kiosk appliance exploration only.
